text: Si ɓe tuubanii Alla ɓe yaltii e keeferaaku, ɓe ñiiɓii e julde, ɓe jonnii asakal jawle maɓɓe ɗen -haray ɓe wonii juulɓe siɗɓe mo'on ka diina; on fotii e ɗi fow, dagantaako on haɓugol ɓe, tawde lislaamu on hiwii(reenii) ƴiiƴe maɓɓe e jawle e teddule maɓɓe ɗen fow. Meɗen ɓannginana Aayeeje ɗen yimɓe annduɓe, ko ɓen nafitorta ɗe ɓe nafa woɗɓe goo.
